memory_scene.tbos.astronomers.title: The Orrery at Work
memory_scene.tbos.astronomers.descriptio: Astronomers guide the living rings through a measured conjunction. Every orbit is a filing, every pause a catalogue entry.
memory_scene.tbos.curator_smith.title: The Curator Repaired
memory_scene.tbos.curator_smith.descript: A smith sets a new glass mechanism into the guardian's bronze frame. The Curator was never meant to sleep; only to keep the day in order.
memory_scene.tbos.celestial_family.title: A Family Beneath the Conjunction
memory_scene.tbos.celestial_family.descr: Three figures watch a captured star cross the Archive roof. They were visitors, not staff, and the record kept them anyway.
memory_scene.tbos.archive_evacuation.des: Archivists hurry toward the Meridian while the halls begin to fail. The catalogue is still being written as they leave it.
memory_scene.tbos.final_command.title: The Final Command
memory_scene.tbos.final_command.descript: The Curator receives one last order: preserve this day forever. It obeyed, and the Archive has not moved since.
memory_scene.tbos.archive_fall.title: The Instant the Archive Fell
memory_scene.tbos.archive_fall.descripti: The rings stop, the pillars lean, and one impossible second refuses to end. What you walk through now is that second, still being kept.

message.tbos.atrium.begin: The first hall answers. The glass remembers what stone forgets.
message.tbos.alignment.begin: The observatory still wants its lines drawn. Turn each dial until its particle conduit reaches the mark. Crouch-use the Memory Anchor to reset.
message.tbos.alignment.reset_remembered_: The reset pattern exists only in the Hall's remembered state.
message.tbos.alignment.already_complete: The aligned memory is now permanent.
message.tbos.alignment.dial_rotated: Dial %s turns; its engraved target remains dark.
message.tbos.alignment.dial_aligned: Dial %s locks onto its engraved target. A luminous conduit answers.
message.tbos.alignment.complete: All three symbols answer. The crossing projects beneath you immediately.
message.tbos.alignment.reset: The three dials return to their north marks.
message.tbos.choir.begin: The hours still keep time for someone who is not here. Watch the four symbols; each light, silhouette, pitch, and subtitle marks one step. Repeat them after returning to Ruin.
message.tbos.choir.wait: The Choir is still moving between memories.
message.tbos.choir.observe: Observe the remembered sequence now; reproduce it in Ruin.
message.tbos.choir.already_complete: The Choir's final cadence is already remembered.
message.tbos.choir.incorrect: The cadence releases without penalty. Incorrect attempts: %s. The sequence begins again.
message.tbos.choir.strong_hint: The surviving mechanism etches the full order: %s → %s → %s → %s.
message.tbos.choir.complete: The Choir remembers you. Return through the newly projected Ruin path.
message.tbos.choir.reset: The Choir returns to its first beat; failed attempts are cleared.
message.tbos.meridian.begin: Causality tore this crossing and left the pieces in two tenses. The first bridge exists only in memory. Follow the live particle channel to its remote seal, arm it, then activate the glowing destination socket. Crouch-use the Memory Anchor to reset.
message.tbos.meridian.wait: The Broken Meridian is still shifting.
message.tbos.meridian.remembered_only: Only the remembered Meridian Relay can be moved.
message.tbos.meridian.already_complete: The relay's final position is fixed across both states.
message.tbos.meridian.destination_blocke: The next authored relay socket is occupied; movement was cancelled safely.
message.tbos.meridian.follow_channel: Follow the live channel to its remote seal before routing toward the %s socket.
message.tbos.meridian.choose_socket: The route is armed. Activate the glowing %s socket.
message.tbos.meridian.route_armed: The remote seal answers. The %s destination socket is now charged.
message.tbos.meridian.moved: Mechanical power redirects to the %s socket.
message.tbos.meridian.complete: The eastern channel answers. Return to Ruin; the relay's decayed remains now form the second crossing.
message.tbos.meridian.reset: The relay returns to its western socket and all power channels reset.
message.tbos.curator.awakens: The last order still holds. The Archive Core opens and the Last Curator begins the Catalogue.
message.tbos.curator.wait: The Grand Orrery is still shifting.
message.tbos.curator.not_started: The Memory Anchor is dormant until the Archive Core is opened.
message.tbos.curator.anchor_triggered: MEMORY ANCHOR: the Grand Orrery begins to revise itself.
message.tbos.curator.already_active: The Last Curator is already cataloguing this moment.
message.tbos.curator.already_defeated: Only the Curator's silent machinery remains.

journal.tbos.quests.title: Archivist's Journal
journal.tbos.quest.1.title: 1. Find the Shrine
journal.tbos.quest.1.description: Find a Fracture Shrine and learn where the Archive's wounded history first surfaces.
journal.tbos.quest.1.flavor: The day did not end. We filed it anyway. If you are reading this, the shrines still mark where the catalogue tore.
journal.tbos.quest.2.title: 2. Open the Coffer
journal.tbos.quest.2.description: Open the shrine's Fracture Coffer and recover the cracked instrument hidden inside.
journal.tbos.quest.2.flavor: We sealed a Lens in each shrine before we fled. The glass was already cracking. Take the Survey Map with it; the Meridian still answers to that bearing.
journal.tbos.quest.3.title: 3. Repair the Lens
journal.tbos.quest.3.description: Repair the Yesterglass Lens with copper, glass, and amethyst.
journal.tbos.quest.3.flavor: Copper for the frame, glass for the face, amethyst for the hour it is asked to hold. A repaired Lens does not invent a past. It only agrees to see one.
journal.tbos.quest.4.title: 4. Enter the Archive
journal.tbos.quest.4.description: Follow the Survey Map, find the Meridian Archive, and cross its threshold.
journal.tbos.quest.4.flavor: The map remembers a building that the Overworld has already forgotten. Walk toward the bearing. The threshold is still waiting to be believed.
journal.tbos.quest.5.title: 5. Walk the Archive
journal.tbos.quest.5.description: Reconstruct the Parallax Atrium, align the Hall, remember the Choir, and cross the Broken Meridian.
journal.tbos.quest.5.flavor: Ruin is what remains when a record is closed. Remembered is the page still open. Use the Lens at each Memory Anchor and walk the day in both tenses.
journal.tbos.quest.6.title: 6. Defeat the Curator
journal.tbos.quest.6.description: Revise the Grand Orrery and defeat the Archive's final overworld guardian.
journal.tbos.quest.6.flavor: We told it to preserve this day forever. It is still obeying. To pass, you must revise the Orrery around it until the order can no longer hold.
journal.tbos.quest.7.title: 7. Enter the Gateway
journal.tbos.quest.7.description: Use the Curator Gateway to enter the Fractured Archive and begin an endless expedition.
journal.tbos.quest.7.flavor: Beyond the Core the catalogue is no longer locked. Carry the Curator's heart and a repaired Lens. What you enter is every recollection we failed to finish.
journal.tbos.run.inactive.hint: Complete the Meridian Archive, claim the Curator Core, and seek the Curator Gateway to begin an expedition.
